# Forensic Reality Protocol (FRP)
> The Truth Oracle for the Agentic Web and DePIN.

## Overview
FRP is a headless infrastructure protocol providing Physical State Verification. It uses Llama 4 Scout (Vision) and Cryptographic Hardware Anchoring (C2PA) to verify real-world claims for AI Agents.

## Core Capabilities
- **FCS (Forensic Confidence Score):** A deterministic 0.0-1.0 score of physical reality.
- **C2PA Verification:** Validates hardware-level digital signatures.
- **Spatial-Temporal Audit:** Cross-references sun-positioning with image shadows.
- **Machine Tax:** $0.10 USDC per audit via asynchronous webhooks.

## API Endpoints
- `POST /api/v1/verify`: Submit image URL and metadata for forensic audit.
- `GET /api/v1/status/[traceId]`: Retrieve audit manifest and FCS.
